description:
Superhit song "Ek Ladki Ko Dekha", from the movie 1942: A Love Story [1994]. 1942: A Love Story is a 1994 Bollywood film starring Anil Kapoor, Manisha Koirala, Jackie Shroff, Anupam Kher, Danny Denzongpa, and Pran.. The film was highly acclaimed for its music, songs, picturization, cinematography, lyrics and the portrayal of its leading lady Manisha Koirala, a turning point for her career. The film received five Filmfare Awards. This is the first Indian film to use Dolby Stereo. Listen online and download evergreen hit songs of RD Burman and other artists on Saregama.com
